resolvedFindings.issue: Unverified profile email disclosed another hosted workspace application status
resolvedFindings.change: Cross-workspace duplicate lookup is allowed only for the confirmed account email; arbitrary email edits use workspace-only history.
resolvedFindings.regression: Two accounts have identical public review results before and after a foreign confirmed receipt. Authorized cross-workspace and same-workspace dedup remain covered.

resolvedFindings.issue: Stale browser page could retarget account actions after a sign-in change
resolvedFindings.change: Pairing requires expectedAccountId. Delete, revoke and recovery require expectedWorkspaceId and validate it before business-state changes.
resolvedFindings.regression: Two-account snapshots preserve profiles, revisions, pairing codes, sessions, uploads, plans, attempts, expired dispatch state and private file bytes under stale/missing preconditions.

resolvedFindings.issue: Stale browser page could download the currently signed-in account export or PDF instead of its displayed workspace
resolvedFindings.change: Export and PDF GET require one matching expectedWorkspaceId query; generated document paths include that binding.
resolvedFindings.regression: Stale, missing and duplicate targets return conflict before any R2 read; matching-owner exports and PDF downloads succeed.

resolvedFindings.issue: Displayed account email could differ silently from the email last confirmed for applications
resolvedFindings.change: Read-only account GET returns confirmedEmail and emailUpdateRequired; explicit bound pairing remains the operation that refreshes email and invalidates the old profile revision.
resolvedFindings.regression: Mismatch GET leaves all workspace data and approvals unchanged; a valid pairing refresh clears the flag and invalidates old approval.

resolvedFindings.issue: Browser pairing countdown relied only on a client wall-clock deadline
resolvedFindings.change: Pairing response now includes serverTime for the UI to measure a server-relative TTL.
resolvedFindings.regression: Application and workerd pairing checks assert a positive server-relative TTL no greater than five minutes; UI clock logic is separately owned.

resolvedFindings.issue: Standalone unverified email could disclose or retire another workspace application history
resolvedFindings.change: Prepare, cooldown retirement and dispatch dedup are workspace-scoped; the legacy global email unique index is removed on service startup while records remain intact.
resolvedFindings.regression: Separate unverified workspaces cannot infer a private receipt or mutate its cooldown/activity; same-workspace duplicate dispatch still blocks, and a legacy-index migration preserves existing records.

contracts.workspaceOwnership: Stable Sites subject; no email-based workspace merge

authScope: Sites owns hosted sign-in. Google through the ChatGPT sign-in screen remains SIWC; no direct Google OAuth, external-provider credential, or separate browser session stack was added.
standaloneTrustBoundary: Operator pairing binds a workspace, not verified applicant email ownership. Operators must pair phones to the same workspace to share duplicate and cooldown protection.
limitations: Tests use isolated synthetic identities, local storage and synthetic employer responses; no production account, database, CV, provider submission, or hosted deployment was accessed or changed by these checks.
Hosted trusted Sites header injection and live browser UI require separate platform/deployment verification.
The coordinated browser UI must send the new preconditions and implement the countdown/email notices. Old browser pages fail closed until reloaded.
The standalone migration was exercised only in a temporary synthetic ledger; no existing production database was opened.
scope: Only the seven listed backend/test/evidence files were edited in this lane; no native app, mirrored hosted checkout, publication, signing, store or account configuration action.
